versions.changelog:
Initial release of the build-mcp-server skill, a guided entry point for developing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for Claude.

- Provides step-by-step discovery to determine the ideal MCP server shape, deployment model, and tool-design pattern.
- Batches conversational questions to clarify user requirements before recommending an architecture.
- Covers all deployment options: remote HTTP, elicitation, MCP app, MCPB, and local stdio.
- Prioritizes Claude integration, including connector docs and relevant constraints.
- Hands off to other skills for specialized scaffolding depending on needs.
- Includes practical guidance for tool schema design and action surface management.
